name: arXiv / Nature / PubMed Journals
author: OmniDesk
description: Scientific literature stream across arXiv, Nature RSS, bioRxiv, and PubMed with DOI citation lookup, bilingual abstract synthesis, and one-click PDF handoff.

config_schema.label: 启用的学术数据源
config_schema.description: Comma-separated journal sources to query: arxiv, nature, biorxiv, pubmed.

config_schema.label: 网络请求超时（秒）
config_schema.description: Timeout in seconds for arXiv, Nature RSS, bioRxiv, PubMed, and Crossref requests.

config_schema.label: 单次最大返回条数
config_schema.description: Maximum number of papers returned per source/page query (1-100).

config_schema.label: 优先合成双语摘要
config_schema.description: Automatically synthesize bilingual Chinese abstract/title via llm.translate.v1 or llm.chat.v1 when available.

config_schema.label: arXiv 默认学科分类
config_schema.description: Comma-separated arXiv subject categories used when no search query is provided.

config_schema.label: Nature RSS 订阅地址
config_schema.description: Comma-separated HTTPS RSS/Atom feed URLs for Nature journals.

config_schema.label: bioRxiv / medRxiv 服务器
config_schema.description: Default Cold Spring Harbor preprint server for bioRxiv feed queries.

config_schema.label: bioRxiv 回溯天数
config_schema.description: Lookback window in days for recent bioRxiv/medRxiv preprint listings.

config_schema.label: PubMed 默认检索式
config_schema.description: Default PubMed ESearch query term when browsing the PubMed channel without search input.

config_schema.label: Crossref Polite Mailto（可选）
config_schema.description: Optional contact email included in User-Agent/mailto for polite Crossref DOI lookups.

config_schema.label: NCBI PubMed API Key（可选）
config_schema.description: Optional NCBI E-utilities API key stored exclusively in 0600 SecretVault.
